Trump questions UK's Chagos deal, seeks AI pact with Britain

Former US President Donald Trump has criticized the United Kingdom's deal to return the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, suggesting that the new British Prime Minister, Keir Starmer, would reconsider the decision. Trump also indicated that the UK is seeking a "reset" with the US, focusing on defense and artificial intelligence pacts. Separately, British Prime Minister Starmer asked Trump to raise the case of Jimmy Lai with Chinese President Xi Jinping. The Chagos Islands handover is valued at $4.5 billion, with Mauritius seeking a breakthrough at the UN General Assembly.
